description: This file defines the class `Transaction` in the namespace `Opencart\-Catalog\-Model\-Account`. The class manages customer transaction data, including adding, deleting, and retrieving transactions from the database in an OpenCart project.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Model class for handling customer transactions in the account namespace for OpenCart.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new customer transaction record to the database using customer ID, order ID, description, and amount.

methods.name: deleteTransaction
methods.description: Deletes a customer transaction based on customer ID and optionally order ID.

methods.name: deleteTransactionByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transactions associated with a specific order ID where the amount is negative.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a specific customer, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total number of transactions for a given customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions linked to a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of amounts for all transactions of a specific customer.
